text:
Supply order: Zelby depot (465 ladders, 360 lanterns, 155 helmets).

Room preferences: Pia (garden studio), Nils (harbour), Esme (east wing), Cora (loading bay), Greta (garden studio), Kira (north office). Ines, Jonah, Teo, Mira (cold). Ada (loading bay). Opal notes garden studio too cold in evening.

Clearance: Bram (library annex, north office), Greta/Pia (harbour), Ada (north office), Suri (east wing), Una (library annex), Dell (north office), Pia/Vik/Jonah (loading bay). Cora wants library annex clear for visitors. Jonah wants east wing clear for visitors.

Status: Sick: Hugo, Mira, Una, Finn, Greta, Vik, Jonah, Ada, Pia, Suri. Slow lifts: east wing, harbour, loading bay. Umbrellas: east wing, library annex, garden studio. Coffee machines: loading bay, garden studio (working), north office (fixed), east wing, harbour.

Updates: Print room repainting (afternoon noise). East wing repainting (morning noise). North office repainting (morning noise). Evening stand-up moved to loading bay. Leon, Dell, Rafe involved.

Pending: Send notes to Bram, Cora, Hugo, Una, Ada. Check with Opal before evening meeting. Remind about Greta’s preference. Check with Suri before morning meeting. Check with Esme before morning meeting.

Coverage: Kira covers Mira; Cora covers Suri.
